entry.title: /v/ Video Games: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 is ultimately a story about grief and letting go. Ve…
entry.content: Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 is ultimately a story about grief and letting go. Verso’s ending captures that beautifully: destroying the Canvas means accepting that some things cannot, and perhaps shouldn’t, be preserved forever. It’s bittersweet rather than triumphant, forcing the Dessendre family to face reality and mourn instead of endlessly rewriting their loss. Painful, beautiful, and fitting, it asks whether loving someone can sometimes mean finally letting them go. It is time we apologized.

entry.title: Announcing 4chan's Vulnerability Disclosure Program
entry.content: In response to last month’s intrusion , we’ve put numerous additional security measures in place in an effort to mitigate and prevent future intrusions. We’re also pleased to announce the creation of 4chan's Vulnerability Disclosure Program —commonly known as a “bug bounty.” We hope that by providing an officially sanctioned way for security researchers to submit security-related bugs, we’ll be in a better position to detect and respond to vulnerabilities that may impact the site and its users.
